name: Samsung Galaxy M52 5G

charge_control.note: Verified on SM-M526B (phase0.sh charge-discover --test, 2026-11-21): 1 cuts USB input (plug shows none), so the phone runs from the battery (about -217 mA) until it is set back to 0.
One UI 'Protect battery' cap in percent; writable on SM-M526B. Uncertain: verify.
Retail demo mode: pauses charging only above about 70% and resumes near 60%. Last resort. Uncertain: verify.

autoboot.note: Not proven yet on SM-M526B: no auto-boot module installed. Run phase0.sh autoboot --test once one is.

notes: Galaxy M52 5G (m52xq, Snapdragon 778G 'lahaina'), launched with Android 11; tested on Android 13 / One UI 5.1, build M526BXXS7CYD2. Magisk sits in the boot image, so root survives a reboot (Phase 0 PASS).
current_now: milliamps, negative while discharging (-217 with USB input cut, -10 when full on USB). Confirm with phase0.sh current-sign.

Thermal: the modem-mmw* zones read a constant 2 C (the M52 has no mmWave), so modem uses mdmss and modem-lte only. xo-therm, quiet-therm and sdm-skin-therm read n/a; modem-skin-usr is the working skin zone.
Keep automatic updates off and stay on One UI 7 or older: One UI 8 removed bootloader unlocking. Samsung's update clients (com.wssyncmldm, com.sec.android.soagent) are removed on the test phone.
One UI stops background apps aggressively: set the Agent to Unrestricted battery use and add it to 'Never sleeping apps' (the hsm-keepalive module also whitelists it from Doze).
Dial *#0011# for the service menu (band and signal) to cross-check the Signal Finder.
